kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total company revenue, which declined in 2025 due to weakening demand in automotive and industrial markets
kpis.signal: Revenue decline due to reduced demand in automotive and industrial markets

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Company gross margin, which declined in 2025 due to lower demand, underutilization of manufacturing facilities, and rising costs
kpis.signal: Gross margin decline due to reduced demand, manufacturing underutilization...

kpis.name: Power Solutions Group Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Power Solutions Group segment, the company's largest segment
kpis.description: Revenue from the Power Solutions Group (PSG), the company's key growth segment, which declined in 2025 due to lower demand in automotive and industrial markets, with a slight increase in AI data centers
kpis.signal: PSG revenue decline due to reduced demand in automotive and...

kpis.name: AMG Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Advanced Manufacturing Group segment, primarily serving automotive and industrial markets.
kpis.description: AMG revenue declined for the third consecutive year, pressured by lower automotive and industrial volumes. The reduction of low-margin manufacturing services at EFK partially mitigated the margin impact.

kpis.name: ISG Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Intelligent Sensing Group segment, serving automotive, industrial, and other sensor applications.
kpis.description: ISG recorded the steepest relative decline among segments (-17.5%), exacerbated by $230.3 million in obsolete inventory charges tied to the 2025 manufacturing realignment program. Gross margin collapsed to 15.1%.

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable to ON
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to ON Semiconductor shareholders after minority interest deductions.
kpis.description: Net income plummeted 92.3% to $121 million, primarily due to $666.9 million in restructuring charges and sharply lower volumes. Operating profitability is reduced to minimal levels.

kpis.name: Net Restructuring Charges
kpis.explanation: Exceptional costs related to manufacturing realignment programs, including severance and asset impairments.
kpis.description: Restructuring charges surged to $666.9 million in 2025 from $133.9 million in 2024, reflecting the scale of the 2025 manufacturing realignment program (severance + asset impairments). This exceptional level heavily weighed on operating income.

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses
kpis.explanation: R&D spending in absolute terms, representing ON Semiconductor's innovation effort as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses declined moderately to $583.6 million (-4.7%), now representing ~10% of revenue versus 9% in 2024, indicating the innovation base is preserved despite the restructuring plan. The reduction focused on external supplies and services.

kpis.name: Total Revenue 2025
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue for the 2025 fiscal year
kpis.description: Total company revenue in 2025, which declined 15.3% due to lower demand in automotive and industrial markets, alongside the implementation of the manufacturing restructuring program
kpis.signal: Significant revenue decline due to reduced demand in automotive and industrial markets

risks.title: Supplier dependency and supply chain disruption
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on suppliers for critical components and materials. Supply chain interruptions could lead to delivery delays and impact production capacity.

risks.title: Increased competition in the semiconductor sector
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector with larger, more integrated players, creating risks of market share losses and margin pressure.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data privacy risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity risks due to the sensitive nature of its operations, reliance on information technology, and global presence.

risks.title: Dependence on R&D to maintain competitiveness
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on R&D innovation to remain competitive. Delays or failures in new product development could undermine its market position.

risks.title: Regulatory and government compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces regulatory risks due to the international scope of its operations, export restrictions, and compliance with complex government regulations.

risks.title: Geopolitical and macroeconomic risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical and macroeconomic risks due to the global nature of its operations, economic volatility, and international trade tensions.

risks.title: Credit and financial liquidity risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces credit risks due to its reliance on external financing and changing market conditions that could affect its borrowing capacity.

ai_positioning.summary: ON Semiconductor recognizes the potential of AI data center markets in its 2025 10-K filing. While AI is not a central theme of the overall strategy, the company identifies AI data center products as a key market within its PSG (Power Solutions Group) segment, where it offers energy-efficient power solutions for next-generation AI data center processors and racks. Revenue from AI data center products increased by $15.1 million in 2025.
evidence: AI data center market mentioned in Business Overview as growth opportunity
PSG segment revenue from AI data centers increased by $15.1 million in 2025
